chunks: Ali, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'When the free woman is under the slave, so the divorce and the waiting period is with the women, meaning he divorces her three times, and she waits for three menstruations.'
ai.seo_question: What is the divorce and waiting period ruling for a free woman married to a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of mixed-status marriages, establishing that the higher social rank of the free woman dictates the divorce procedure, requiring three pronouncements and a waiting period of three menstrual cycles. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic principle that in cases of disparity between spouses, the legal obligations often follow the status of the free party to ensure her rights are fully protected. It serves as a foundational text for understanding how social hierarchy influences personal status law in early Islamic jurisprudence.
